name: Vega
dof_breakdown: head 3, torso 3, arms 7 each, plus hands
price_note: reported US$81k (no hands) to $96k (dexterous hands); $89,999 at pre-order
summary: A US-built wheeled humanoid whose torso unfolds to reach about 2.2 m for overhead work, on an omnidirectional base with Jetson Orin compute. The California startup opened pre-orders in 2025 for industrial and R&D customers.

sources.title: California Startup Dexmate Opens Preorders for Vega — Mike Kalil
